question: In February 2023, Shiv Pratap Shukla was appointed governor of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In February 2023, **Shiv Pratap Shukla** was appointed as the governor of **Himachal Pradesh**.
 
• The appointment was part of a series of gubernatorial appointments and reshuffles made by the President of India.
 
• Shiv Pratap Shukla
